Name: teamLab Planets TOKYO
Notes: Walk barefoot through knee-deep water and a digital koi pond, plus the Floating Flower Garden with live orchids. More physical than Borderless. Extended to 2027; from ~¥3,800.

Name: Ghibli Museum, Mitaka
Notes: Advance tickets only. December tickets go on sale at 10am JST on Nov 10 (Nov 9, 5pm Pacific) via Lawson Ticket. ¥1,000; closed Tuesdays; no photos inside.

Name: Immersive Fort Tokyo
Notes: Indoor 'immersive theme park' with theater-style shows; 1-day pass from ~¥6,800 plus show fees. Most shows are in Japanese, so check for English-friendly ones.

Name: Arashiyama Hanatouro
Hours: Lights from about 17:00, Dec 8-17, 2026 per the line
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市右京区嵯峨天龍寺芒ノ馬場町
Notes: Lantern-lit paths Dec 8–17, 2026, from Togetsukyo Bridge through the Bamboo Grove to Nonomiya Shrine, the river path, and the Jojakko-ji and Nison-in approach (~90 min). Lights from ~5pm; best 5:30–7:30. Free to walk; weeknights are calmer. JR Sagano Line to Saga-Arashiyama (12 min). Dress warm (4–8°C); eat dinner back in central Kyoto. Update: Address is the start of the route (Togetsukyo Bridge); 2026 dates not independently verified.

Name: Tenryu-ji
Address (JA): 京都府京都市右京区嵯峨天龍寺芒ノ馬場町68
Notes: Special night opening during Hanatouro, ~¥1,000. Lines build after 6pm, so go early.

Name: teamLab Botanical Garden Osaka
Hours: Evenings from sunset; closed 2nd and 4th Mondays (per the line)
Address (JA): 大阪府大阪市東住吉区長居公園1-23 長居植物園
Notes: Permanent night-only artworks in a real botanical garden; starts after sunset. Closed the 2nd and 4th Mondays; can be cancelled in bad weather. Cold in December, so dress warm.

Name: Nintendo Museum
Address (JA): 京都府宇治市小倉町神楽田56
Notes: On Nintendo's old Uji factory site: giant two-player controller games, hanafuda (playing card) workshop; ticket includes 10 coins for hands-on exhibits. ¥3,300. Lottery entry only, about 3 months ahead, so December's main draw has likely passed; watch for cancellations released about 2 months out. Closed Tuesdays. Update: Tickets are by lottery with a free Nintendo Account, credit card only, ID checked on the day; entries currently open for Feb 2027. Price (3,300 yen) not on the page.
